question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Malice
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Sympathy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Malice"** means the desire to harm someone or ill will. It is the intention or desire to do evil. (द्वेष, शत्रुता)

 
 
• **Example:** His actions were driven by pure malice, intending to ruin her reputation.
 
 
 
• **"Sympathy"** refers to feelings of pity and compassion for someone else's misfortune. It is the opposite of malice as it represents kindness and understanding rather than ill will. (सहानुभूति)
 
 
• **Example:** She expressed her sympathy by helping the family during their tough time.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **'Malice'** is **'Sympathy.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Animosity** (शत्रुता): Strong hostility or dislike towards someone.

 
 
• **Example:** Their animosity towards each other was evident during the debate.
 
 
 
• **Resentment** (आक्रोश): Bitter indignation at having been treated unfairly.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt deep resentment after being excluded from the team.
 
 
 
• **Antipathy** (घृणा): A deep-seated feeling of aversion or dislike.
 
 
• **Example:** He had a strong antipathy towards dishonest people.
